titles.romaji: Maid Kyouiku.: Botsuraku Kizoku Rurikawa Tsubaki - THE ANIMATION
titles.native: メイド教育。－没落貴族 瑠璃川椿－ THE ANIMATION

description: The prestigious aristocratic Rurikawa family has fallen.... Tsubaki, the daughter of the Rurikawa family, a beautiful girl of the highest caliber, is picked up by Lord Poiman, a powerful aristocrat, and begins a new life. However, she becomes his personal maid. Tsubaki acts stoutly so as not to lose her aristocratic pride even in a situation where she is not allowed to disobey, but her mind and body are thoroughly tortured and defiled by her master's perverted "maid education," and unwanted climaxes are mercilessly inflicted on her. In order to become a full-fledged "maid", "fallen aristocrat Rurikawa Tsubaki" will fall to any extent...
